language_task: Seperate the food and the toys into the two bowls.
outcome_evidence: The robot places the orange-shaped food item in the green bowl (frames 114–120), the pink and blue plush toys in the light-blue bowl (frames 333–339 and 497–503), and the carrot and brown oval food item in the green bowl (frames 662–668 and 815–820), visible in wrist_cam and corroborated by overhead_cam. Frames 840–846 show all three food-shaped objects together in the green bowl and both plush toys together in the light-blue bowl, with no objects left outside and no observed failed attempts or unintended side effects.
